rawContent: What a happy day! Ordered and got an early approval for two new #Metoo books! Looking forward to reading it @robinfield @drjerricajordan and @taintedwitness!! https://t.co/K0hnkzTJj2

Working on the #MeToo and South Asia’s edited volume’s reading and realized I had a source that I had gotten a while back while starting to work on my dissertation years ago. How cool to come back to it again: Radha Kumar’s The History of Doing! https://t.co/VyQQ2sIJ6K
In a difficult day today, one of my students told me that she had taken my class because of the #MeToo symposiums I have organized in class today. It made my day. Little things mean so much!

My copy of #MeToo and Modernism arrived today edited by @robinfield and @drjerricajordan! @robinfield is also contributing to our #MeToo and South Asia edited volume, which I, @ruma_sinha_1, and @billieguarino are excited about! https://t.co/iFtOSntckl

Please come join us at our @northeastMLA panel: “Reimagining #MeToo in South Asia and In the Diaspora” on Thursday, 2:45pm - 4:15pm at Classroom/Culinary 234 @ruma_sinha_1 @billieguarino @yaldahamidi @Turni_Ch https://t.co/ZOlpGlnbJE

We had a successful @northeastMLA panel with @yaldahamidi, @Turni_Ch, @billieguarino, and Ruma Sinha on a panel on #Metoo and South Asia. We had productive discussions which we wanted to continue after our panel ended! Such a wonderful day! https://t.co/RSfdtbNk8L

So excited to share that for SP 2023’s #MeToo event at @sacredheartuniversity . We will be hosting Ram Devineni, the founder and creator of @powerofpriya on April 12th at 2pm at the Michelle Loris Forum. The event is free and open to public! @WomenStudiesSHU @shuenglishdept https://t.co/PKAUuYN4ap

Snippets from yesterday’s #MeToo event at @sacredheartuniv! Thank you @powerofpriya for giving a wonderful talk about the origins of Priya’s Shakti @WomenStudiesSHU @shuenglishdept https://t.co/H0DyQBo0F9
So excited to see @sacredheartuniv’s coverage of our Spring #MeToo event! @WomenStudiesSHU @shuenglishdept @powerofpriya @rattapallax https://t.co/MVjYasAWKO
Currently reading: @cmardoro’s Toward a New Feminist Theory of Rape (2002) to discuss with my co-editors for our #MeToo volume this Friday! https://t.co/HCzPO1wTN4

In my American lit for elementary students class, my students were asked to pick books or something related to their profession, and present on it: they chose books on consent and speaking up (#metoo movement), disability and special needs (Salem witch trials), and on inclusivity

Having worked on #MeToo and South Asia for so long, sometimes I forget that the work we do does make a difference somewhere. ☺️ so all in all, it ended on a good note. Looking forward to seeing our edited volume come to life ☺️

So excited to see @robinfield’s #MeToo and India: The Movement in Its Moment” in print. So excited to be a part of the provocations cluster with @pallavi_guha, @ProfSonoraJha, and @BasuSrimati! It’s open-access for 3 months!!

My article and contribution to @robinfield’s newly released #MeToo and India: The Movement In Its Moment” is now available for reading. It was such a pleasure to work on this initiative and be in such wonderful company along with @pallavi_guha, @ProfSonoraJha, and Srimati Basu. https://t.co/enFEdvAYbB
Congratulations @BasuSrimati! I look forward to reading your essay on the Hindi film, Darlings for the forum #MeToo and India forum on South Asian Review!

@gvaughnjoy Not that I am aware of - I am co-editing the #MeToo edited volume, and am also working on summer research for my monograph and to send a book proposal this year to a university press once the research is done.

I began @TaranaBurke’s Unbound accordingly to Goodreads around 2021, when her memoir came out and was chosen by @literati years ago. It took me 2 years to read it, but I am glad and relieved I took my time with her story. #MeToo #TaranaBurke @Flatironbooks https://t.co/PU4lCiaoWx
